name: cutout-card
blurb: Image card with angled corner cutouts and contextual action reveal.
description: A composable card layout with geometric corner cutouts, media area, image zoom on hover, and content sections. Actions reveal on hover via context.
use_when: Feature cards, product showcases, or portfolio items where corner geometry adds visual interest and focus states.
avoid_when: Dense card layouts where corner cutouts create alignment challenges or where interaction is touch-only.
a11y: Context-driven; children inherit hover state. Corners are decorative SVGs marked aria-hidden. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
